# Dario Espinosa — Lead Experience Designer

> Portfolio site: https://darioespinosa.design
> Contact: despi@softserveinc.com
> LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/data-espinosa/
> Behance: https://behance.net/darioespinosa
> Location: Chiapas, Mexico

## About

Dario Espinosa is a Lead Experience Designer at SoftServe with 15+ years of experience designing digital products across telecom, healthcare, energy, eCommerce, spatial computing, and AI-assisted tools. He works at the intersection of UX strategy, design systems, and AI-native product design.

His approach is grounded in research-first thinking, accessibility compliance (WCAG 2.1 AA), and close collaboration with engineering and product teams. He has led solo design engagements and built UX Centers of Excellence from zero.

## Current Role

**Lead Experience Designer — SoftServe** (2022–present)
Working across multiple enterprise client engagements including a global oil-field services company, NielsenIQ, Siemens, a construction-SaaS platform, a regulated healthcare company, and AT&T México.

## Key Skills

- UX Research & Strategy
- Product Design & Prototyping (Figma)
- Design Systems (Figma, AEM, Flutter)
- AI-Assisted Design Workflows (Claude, Cursor)
- Web Accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA, IFETEL-recognized)
- Spatial & Immersive Design (Unity, Spatial)
- Vibe-coding with Claude Code & Cursor
- Adobe Experience Manager (AEM / CQ5)
- eCommerce (Magento 2, Adobe Commerce)
- HTML5, CSS, JavaScript

## Portfolio Case Studies

Full filterable case-study index: https://darioespinosa.design/work.html

### BlendOps — AI-Powered Blend Optimizer (current)
Replacing a decades-old Excel model with an ML-driven web app for oil-well fluid optimization at a global oil-field services company. Designed using an AI-assisted prototyping workflow with Claude, reaching React-ready fidelity at v7 prototype.
URL: https://darioespinosa.design/blendops.html

### VOS — VIRTU4L Operations System with Local AI (personal project)
A Slack-native operations brain for a real-world VR venue in Chiapas, Mexico. Features daily checklists, reservations, sales tracking, and Dasha — a locally-hosted AI assistant (Ollama). Built with Claude Code and Cursor. 293 tests passing, 4 Slack channels, 0 public URLs.
URL: https://darioespinosa.design/virtu4lslacksagent.html

### NielsenIQ Dashboard Redesign
Improved feature delivery speed by 30% and cut UX bugs by 50% by introducing Double Track Agile and a consolidated Figma design system to a burned-out analytics product team.
URL: https://darioespinosa.design/nielseniq.html

### Siemens Railway Backoffice Overhaul
Reduced operator task time by 40% and onboarding time by 60% — redesigning a safety-critical legacy C++ backoffice system with a component-driven Figma + Flutter design system. WCAG 2.1 AA compliant.
URL: https://darioespinosa.design/siemens.html

### AT&T México Digital Transformation (15 years)
Boosted online sales by 500% and reached 96% accessibility compliance — leading AT&T México's digital transformation through Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), 40+ custom components, complete eCommerce redesign, and a first-of-its-kind voice contract accessibility program. Recognized by IFETEL Mexico.
URL: https://darioespinosa.design/att.html

### OolaLife Web Platform
Delivered 80% user adoption increase — transforming a COVID-cancelled book tour into a mobile-first digital platform with gamified progress tracking (streaks, rewards, 7 life areas). 50 user interviews, 4 personas, 5-month delivery.
URL: https://darioespinosa.design/oolalife.html

### Healthcare SaaS — UX Center of Excellence
Built a UX CoE from zero in a regulated healthcare environment. Improved design-to-dev efficiency by 50% and user adoption by 80%.
URL: https://darioespinosa.design/benefitbridge.html

### SoftServe Metaverse Experience
Attracted 1,500+ virtual visitors to a fully navigable immersive exhibition at a major European tech convention — designed in 4 months using Spatial and Unity.
URL: https://darioespinosa.design/metaverse.html

### UX Research at Scale
Cut research turnaround by 50% and drove cross-team adoption of UX methodology — building scalable research guidelines and AI-assisted synthesis workflows across construction SaaS product verticals.
URL: https://darioespinosa.design/research-at-scale.html
